TextItem.Description: Stay at comfortable all-suites hotel convenient to major business venues and attractions in the Valle area, and enjoy amenities like a Pantry, laundry room and complimentary breakfast and Internet access.

This Award Winning Monterrey Hotel is a Travelers Dream. Guests encounter a sense of peace and tranquility as soon as they enter the Staybridge Suites Monterrey San Pedro hotel. The lush mountains that surround the hotel s property in Monterrey are a perfect backdrop to this lively, growing metropolis. Exclusive residential areas, fine restaurants and boutiques are all within reach of the hotel. San Pedro has become Mexico s center for commerce and industry. Cemex, GM, GE and the American Consulate are all easily accessible to guests here for business purposes. You can stay connected with home and the office with free high speed Internet access. The flexible stay options are perfect for weekend travelers, corporate relocation or an extended business project. Situated in San Pedros Zona Valle, the hotel has easy access to main corporate offices, as well as top area attractions. You can view the entire city from the top of Obispado Bishops Palace, visit one of many museums or go sightseeing in nearby Huasteca Canyon or Chipinque. You can also shop at high end boutiques while strolling through Paseo de los Duendes in Calzada del Valle. Monterrey and San Pedro draw thousands of guests each year. Why not stay at a place that feels like home? The outdoor pool and grill, Great Room and complimentary hot breakfast are just a few of the many amenities we offer guests. So "Get Comfortable" and enjoy your stay with us!
